browser.version_note: Native report was not written before the resource watchdog stopped the job.

backend.endpoint_note: CI runtime URL is masked in job logs; no native report was available to record its non-secret endpoint.

guest.cause: The watchdog first recorded RESOURCE_CPU_HIGH_LOAD_BUSY (0.61 busy, one-minute load 7.27 on four logical CPUs), then RESOURCE_CPU_BUSY and RESOURCE_CPU_HIGH_LOAD_BUSY (0.78 busy, load 8.79). It stopped the owned job group at the safe boundary.

case_verdicts.steps_executed: unknown; native report was not uploaded

failure_classification: Resource-invalid infrastructure interruption, not a product failure. Setup, provenance and measured readiness passed. The runner was stopped during the native exercise after repeated unsafe CPU samples. Only three resource journals were uploaded; the native report was absent, so no Settings behavior can be credited or failed.
product_credit: None. T04 reload persistence remains unverified; this run proves neither pass nor product failure. No blanket Settings acceptance.
limits: Frozen unpublished CI development v0.2.526 at source 0d3cdc1fae475e197e6f06974ac9f5f40d489778; does not establish later main b1c4f6bba or 72fb54c95, Store .527, member/admin, or full Settings. Exact Chrome version and endpoint were not retained because the native report did not upload.
cleanup: Disposable hosted guest profile. No shared credentials or mutable fixture. The hosted job is terminal and its guest resource final is invalid; package and browser resource finals are valid.
